options.content: Enter an exact `session_id` in the dashboard variable (or use `.*` for all sessions) to inspect the Tempo timeline. The query accepts Observatory, OTel `session.id`, and GenAI conversation attributes. Use the event detail and attribution endpoints for exact `workflow_id`, `agent_id`, `subagent_id`, and parent-event relationships. Prometheus intentionally avoids unbounded session labels; Tempo is the timeline store and SQLite is the durable metadata index. Observatory Events values are event-time scoped; use API `start`/`end` filters for complete time-bounded analysis.
